Family — Our homes are the first kingdom outposts. Lord, we declare that Your peace reigns over every hearth, that forgiveness flows faster than anger, and that Your provision multiplies for each need. We stand firm in the authority of Your word, knowing that a united family reflects Heaven on earth.  

If you agree, drop a 🙏.  Have a prayer request? Share it below.
